title: Chevalley constructibility of the image of a finitely presented morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact, locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and assume $Y$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If $C\subseteq X$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset], then $f(C)\subseteq Y$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset].

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 29.6 (label lemma-image-constructible), Tag 054J (Chevalley's theorem); source read. The exact Lean declaration is AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isConstructible_image.

mathlib_searches.query: Chevalley theorem image of a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of finite presentation is constructible
constructible image of a finitely presented morphism of schemes

mathlib_match.how: Exact: the declaration takes [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (the node's locally finitely presented hypothesis), [QuasiCompact f] (the node's quasi-compact hypothesis), and [CompactSpace Y] plus [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] (the node's quasi-compact and quasi-separated target hypotheses); its IsConstructible input and output are exactly the constructible subset clauses.
